name: Extract Invoice Fields from Google Drive PDFs

parameters.jsCode:
const invoiceText = $input.first().json.text || '';

const payload = {
  model: 'llama-3.3-70b-versatile',
  temperature: 0,
  messages: [
    {
      role: 'system',
      content: 'You are an invoice data extractor. Respond with ONLY a raw valid JSON object. No markdown. No code fences. No explanation. ALL values must be strings. Never return integers or floats.'
    },
    {
      role: 'user',
      content: `Extract ALL of the following from the invoice text and return ONLY a raw JSON object.

CRITICAL RULES:
- Every value must be a STRING. No integers or floats.
- Numbers with comma decimal (719,28) return exactly as-is as string.
- product_id: plain string, never scientific notation.
- If a field is not found return null.

Fields:
- dt: invoice date YYYY-MM-DD
- order_ts: order timestamp, null if not found
- order_id: order or invoice number
- channel: sales channel (Online/Store/App), null if not found
- coupon_code: coupon code, null if not found

- customer: object with:
  - customer_id: ID starting with CUST, null if not found
  - phone: phone number as string, null if not found
  - country: full country name, null if not found
  - country_code: 2-letter ISO code e.g. US, IN, GB, null if not found
  - state: state or province, null if not found

- items: array of ALL line items, each with:
  - item_seq: row number as string
  - sku: SKU or item code if available, null if not found
  - product_name: full product description
  - product_id: find the product code, if explicitly present, if code is not available take the product name , null if not found
  - brand_name: brand extracted from product name (e.g. Dell, HP, Apple, Samsung). Must be consistent — always title case.
  - category_name: infer category from product name (e.g. Computers, Laptops, Phones, Monitors, Accessories). If unclear, infer from context.
  - color: color if mentioned, null if not
  - size: size if mentioned, null if not
  - material: material if mentioned, null if not
  - quantity: as string
  - unit_price_currency: currency code e.g. USD, null if not found
  - unit_price: as string, keep original format
  - discount_pct: string with % e.g. 3%, null if not found
  - tax_rate: the tax rate for this line item as a string e.g. "25", "35".   If the invoice shows one global tax (e.g. TAX 25%), apply that rate to ALL items.  If each item has its own rate, use that item's specific rate.  Return "0" if no tax found.- tax_amount: do NOT calculate this, leave it null. It will be calculated later.

Invoice text:
${invoiceText}`
    }
  ]
};

return [{ json: { groqPayload: payload } }];
